results.name: Roofr → QuickBooks Online
results.description: Roofr exports contacts, catalog items, invoices, and payment data to QuickBooks Online, powered by Agave's embedded integration (currently Beta / limited availability per Roofr's pricing page). Available on Roofr's Scale plan; a Zapier connector is also available.
results.notes: AECI-444: reclassified native→iPaaS, powered_by Agave (consistent with the Agave ERP Sync pattern); maturity=beta per roofr.com/pricing ("QuickBooks integration - Beta") and useagave.com/integrations/quickbooks-online. One-way export claims (Directory & Contacts, Invoices & Payments) unchanged.
